_about: Branch and pull request naming, so an engineering-metrics tool can tell what kind of work each pull request is. Team- or org-owned: edit it here, or keep it in the organisation context repo (install.mjs --org copies it). check: off | warn | block (commit and pull request checks). createBranch: ask (the agent asks before creating the branch locally; it never pushes) | never.

types.when: New capability or enhancement: a User Story or Feature
types.title: feat: {id} {summary}

types.when: Defect found in production: a Bug whose Found In is Production
types.title: hotfix: {id} {summary}

types.when: Defect found in QA or UAT: a Bug whose Found In is QA or UAT, linked to its story
types.title: fix: {id} {summary}

types.when: Maintenance: security findings, vulnerability and image-scan fixes, upgrades; a Task or Story tagged Maintenance
types.title: maint: {id} {summary}

exempt.note: Promotion between sprint and release branches needs no work item: keep the branch names, title it promote: <from> to <to>.

rules: Every pull request is linked to a work item: the work item type says what the work was.
Keep sprint and release branch names: the pipeline needs the release prefix.
Use the right work item type: a new requirement is a Story; a QA or UAT observation is a Bug.
One fix, one work item: pull requests in several repos link to the same Bug.
No shorthand titles: the prefix names the type; the rest says what changed.
